metadata.title: CustomComponent Cookbook
metadata.description: Practical guidance for building CustomComponents with visualization libraries (d3, anime, gsap, rough, confetti).

signature: function render({ props, state, updateState, id, isThumbnail, containerWidth, containerHeight }) { ... }

available_libraries.d3: D3.js - Advanced data visualizations (arcs, scales, force graphs, hierarchies)
available_libraries.anime: Anime.js - Smooth animations (number counting, transitions, easing)
available_libraries.rough: Rough.js - Hand-drawn aesthetics (sketchy charts, whiteboard style)

golden_rules: Extract padding FIRST: var padding = props.padding || 32;
Use React.createElement only (no JSX/imports - libraries already injected)
Do not call updateState during render; only in handlers/useEffect
Define padding FIRST, then calculate availableWidth = width - padding * 2
Extract theme colors from props: primaryColor, secondaryColor, textColor
Check isThumbnail before animations: if (isThumbnail) return;
Use libraries for impressive visuals: d3, anime, gsap, rough, confetti

animated_metric.description: Use anime.js to count numbers up
animated_metric.use_when: Displaying KPIs, stats, percentages that should animate
animated_metric.theme_usage: primaryColor and secondaryColor in gradient text

radial_progress.description: Use d3.arc() for circular progress rings
radial_progress.use_when: Progress indicators, completion rates, single metrics
radial_progress.theme_usage: primaryColor to secondaryColor gradient in SVG defs

staggered_bars.description: Use gsap.from() with stagger for bar charts
staggered_bars.theme_usage: Each bar uses theme color variants

celebration_card.description: Use confetti() on click for achievements

hand_drawn_chart.use_when: Casual presentations, creative designs, informal tone

force_graph.theme_usage: Nodes colored by primaryColor, links by secondaryColor

library_examples.anime_counter: React.useEffect(function() { if (isThumbnail) return; anime({targets: {val: 0}, val: targetValue, duration: 1500, easing: 'easeOutExpo', round: 1, update: function(a) { updateState({current: Math.round(a.animations[0].currentValue)}); }}); }, [targetValue]);
library_examples.d3_arc: var arc = d3.arc().innerRadius(radius-20).outerRadius(radius).startAngle(0); var path = svg.append('path').attr('fill', 'url(#gradient)').transition().duration(1500).attrTween('d', function() { return function(t) { arc.endAngle(angle * t); return arc(); }; });
library_examples.rough_rect: var rc = rough.canvas(canvas); rc.rectangle(x, y, w, h, {stroke: primaryColor, strokeWidth: 2, roughness: 1.5});

theme_integration_rules: Always extract: var primaryColor = props.primaryColor || props.color || '#3B82F6';
SVG gradients: Create defs with stops using primaryColor/secondaryColor
Confetti colors: Pass array [primaryColor, secondaryColor, accentColor]
D3 scales: .range([primaryColor, secondaryColor]) for color interpolation
